caption: The drawing depicts a painted, carved wooden statue standing on a rectangular wooden base. The statue is of a male figure wearing a long, black robe adorned with red details at the collar and shoulder areas. The figure has a light skin tone, black hair, and dark, marked eyebrows, with large, almond-shaped eyes and defined facial features. The right hand is held out in front of the body in a fist-like gesture, while the left hand holds a small, pale skull. The robe appears worn and chipped, revealing undertones of brown and beige in the wood beneath. The background is a plain, off-white or light beige color, with the drawing focused solely on the statue and no additional objects or scenery present. In the bottom left corner, there is text in green that reads: "Hazel G. Claflin - Taos N.M."
title: Bulto - Santa Rita
